verdict.rationale: Terraform has no built-in natural-language interface; its CLI is command-and-flag driven. Its official MCP server does let AI models perform workspace operations and run management and generate configuration, so a user can operate Terraform through an external AI assistant that translates natural language. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command mode in the CLI or HCP UI, documentation of end-to-end natural-language plan/apply workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Workspace operations: Create, update, delete workspaces with support for variables, tags, and run management.
The Terraform MCP server gives AI models real-time access to Terraform provider docs, modules, policies, and HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise workspaces.
AI enhancement: Enables more accurate and actionable Terraform configuration generation.
